title: Shirtless Florida Man Yells at Cars While Slamming Beers — Bodycam
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida deputies confronting a man who was reportedly yelling at passing cars while chugging some beers in June 2023. The Pinellas County Sheriff's Office said Seth Thomas was threatening drivers while walking in the street with a beer in his hand. When deputies arrived, Thomas was wielding a can labeled "Florida Man" beer. Watch what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
